scheduling: seed2 shuffled active-task cycles; same problem on every DDP step
rank_rng: seed2 + 104729 * rank, restored unchanged on an AMP retry
distributed_loss: entire micro-objective including KL * world_size * actual_micro_rows / logical_global_rows

accumulation.synchronization: no_sync on every round except the last common round; zero-weight valid dummy when exhausted
accumulation.gradients: same weights across all microchunks; one unscale, global clip_norm1 and optimizer step per logical batch
accumulation.metrics: detached parts weighted by actual micro rows; dummy rows excluded
accumulation.retry: restore rank RNG at logical start and replay all microchunks; no successful update advance

amp: FP16 GradScaler; collective finite-gradient decision before optimizer update
resume: same-run R76 epoch-boundary last.pt only; optimizer/controller/scaler/all rank RNG restored
prefetch: node-local cache; single async CPU worker, two pinned batch buffers
train_eval: every5, stopping epoch, maximum epoch and selected best
